description: Morphs one PVOC spectrum into another. Amplitude and frequency interpolation start/end times can be controlled independently. The 'mode' parameter (1 vs 2) selects the interpolation curve shape (linear/exp vs cosinusoidal) and is genuinely user-tunable, so it lives in parameters rather than as a curator-pinned submode.
musical_use: Smooth or staged crossfade between two timbres at the spectral level. Independent control of amplitude and frequency morphing lets you have one parameter lead the other — e.g. amplitude morphs early while frequency holds, then frequency catches up. Classic application: morph between two pitched sources, or between a pitched source and a noise-like one.

mode.description: Interpolation curve shape. 1 = linear/exponential (controlled by expa/expf). 2 = cosinusoidal spline.

expa.description: Exponent of amplitude interpolation (mode 1 only). 1 = linear; >1 = increasing slope; <1 = decreasing slope.

stagger.description: Time-delay of entry of the second file.

examples.description: Linear morph from file 1 to file 2 over the first 4 seconds, amplitude leading frequency by 1 second.
examples.expected_use: Spectral morph between two pitched sources where the timbre starts shifting before the pitch does.
